records.localized_text: El encendido del testigo del tablero que representa una batería indica que hay que detenerse inmediatamente para evitar daños al sistema eléctrico

rows.text: Un vehículo con transmisión automática también puede tener un motor de arranque para poner en marcha el motor; el tipo de transmisión no lo elimina.
evidence: HELLA, Checking the starter, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-electronics-and-electrics/starting-and-charging-system/checking-the-starter/ — il motorino innesta il volano per avviare il motore.
Hyundai Tucson 2025, If the engine does not start, https://ownersmanual.hyundai.com/full_webhelp/NX4/2025/en_GN/id5472cd44e76.html — descrive il motorino su veicoli con cambio automatico.

rows.text: El motor de arranque sirve para poner en marcha el motor y se desacopla después. No se hace girar al revés para frenar.
evidence: HELLA, Checking the starter, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-electronics-and-electrics/starting-and-charging-system/checking-the-starter/ — il motorino innesta il volano per avviare il motore.

HELLA, Starter damage assessment, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-electronics-and-electrics/starting-and-charging-system/starter-damage-assessment/ — il motorino deve disinnestarsi dopo l’avviamento.

rows.text: Con el motor en marcha, el alternador alimenta los consumidores eléctricos y mantiene la carga de la batería.
evidence: HELLA, Service work on the charging system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/us/technical/car-electronics-and-electrics/starting-and-charging-system/service-work-on-the-charging-system/ — alternatore alimenta utenze e mantiene la carica.

rows.text: La batería suministra corriente continua: durante la descarga circula en un solo sentido por el circuito externo.
evidence: US DOE, The War of the Currents, https://www.energy.gov/articles/war-currents-ac-vs-dc-power — la batteria eroga corrente continua, in un senso.
US DOE, Batteries, https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1011-92_VOL2.pdf, ES-04 p.4 — batteria immagazzina energia chimica e la converte in elettrica.

rows.text: La batería de servicio suministra corriente continua de baja tensión; el alternador produce corriente alterna, que luego se rectifica.
evidence: US DOE, The War of the Currents, https://www.energy.gov/articles/war-currents-ac-vs-dc-power — la batteria eroga corrente continua, in un senso.

HELLA, Checking the alternator, https://www.hella.com/techworld/sg/technical/car-electronics-and-electrics/starting-and-charging-system/checking-the-alternator/ — alternatore produce tensione alternata rettificata in continua.

rows.text: En las baterías con celdas accesibles se revisa el nivel y, si es necesario, se agrega agua destilada siguiendo las instrucciones del fabricante.
evidence: Suzuki, Warranty and Service Record Booklet, pp. 29–30, Battery fluid level, https://suzukimyanmar.com/frontend/assets/pdf/service/warranty-policy/Warranty_and_Service_Record_Booklet_EN.pdf — verifica del livello, rabbocco con acqua distillata a motore fermo; le sigillate non richiedono rabbocco.

rows.text: Las baterías selladas no necesitan rellenos de rutina. Mantenerlas limpias y secas y proteger los bornes de la corrosión ayuda a su mantenimiento; usa el producto indicado por el fabricante.
evidence: Suzuki, Warranty and Service Record Booklet, pp. 29–30, Battery fluid level, https://suzukimyanmar.com/frontend/assets/pdf/service/warranty-policy/Warranty_and_Service_Record_Booklet_EN.pdf — verifica del livello, rabbocco con acqua distillata a motore fermo; le sigillate non richiedono rabbocco.

Trojan Battery, How to Maintain Your Flooded Lead Acid Battery, Inspecting and Cleaning / Watering, https://www.trojanbattery.com/resources/white-papers-and-articles/how-to-maintain-your-flooded-lead-acid-battery — mantenere pulito e asciutto; vaselina o spray protettivo sui terminali contro la corrosione; solo acqua, preferibilmente distillata, nelle celle.

Bosch, Battery catalogue 2023, p. 13, Automotive Battery Handling Procedure, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/in/services_and_support_1/downloads_10/pdf_5/battery_catalogue_2023.pdf — sconsiglia il grasso su cavi, morsetti e terminali ma raccomanda vaselina sugli stessi; la protezione dipende dal prodotto.

rows.text: Mantener la batería limpia y seca y proteger los bornes limita las fugas de corriente y la corrosión. Usa en los bornes el producto indicado por el fabricante, por ejemplo vaselina si así lo prescribe.
evidence: Trojan Battery, How to Maintain Your Flooded Lead Acid Battery, Inspecting and Cleaning / Watering, https://www.trojanbattery.com/resources/white-papers-and-articles/how-to-maintain-your-flooded-lead-acid-battery — mantenere pulito e asciutto; vaselina o spray protettivo sui terminali contro la corrosione; solo acqua, preferibilmente distillata, nelle celle.

Bosch, Battery catalogue 2023, p. 13, Automotive Battery Handling Procedure, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/in/services_and_support_1/downloads_10/pdf_5/battery_catalogue_2023.pdf — sconsiglia il grasso su cavi, morsetti e terminali ma raccomanda vaselina sugli stessi; la protezione dipende dal prodotto.

Volvo Penta, TAD1641GE Operators Publication, p. 44, Battery Maintenance, https://www.wincogen.com/wp-content/uploads/PD/Engines/volvo_tad1641ge_opm.pdf — sporco e ossido causano correnti disperse; morsetti puliti e protetti con grasso specifico o vaselina.

rows.text: La masa de las baterías aumenta el peso del vehículo: para el mismo recorrido y condiciones puede aumentar la energía consumida para moverlo, reduciendo su autonomía.
evidence: US DOE, Chapter 13 Electric, pp. 13-11–13-12, https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2022-10/Chapter_13-Electric.pdf — massa della batteria incide sul fabbisogno energetico; maggiore peso aumenta il consumo per miglio.

rows.text: En vehículos pesados es común un sistema de servicio de 24 V, separado del posible circuito de tracción de alta tensión.
evidence: Volvo Trucks, FL Electric, https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2019/nov/tech-in-focus-volvo-fl-electric.html — batterie a 24 V alimentano elettronica e servizi del camion.

HELLA, Intelligent battery sensor IBS for 24 V systems, https://www.hella.com/soe/en/News/Intelligent-battery-sensor-IBS-for-24-V-vehicle-electrical-systems-5273/ — sistemi a 24 V per camion e autobus, termici ed elettrici.

rows.text: La batería suministra corriente continua, no alterna. El alternador produce corriente alterna, que se rectifica para el sistema eléctrico.
evidence: US DOE, The War of the Currents, https://www.energy.gov/articles/war-currents-ac-vs-dc-power — la batteria eroga corrente continua, in un senso.

HELLA, Checking the alternator, https://www.hella.com/techworld/sg/technical/car-electronics-and-electrics/starting-and-charging-system/checking-the-alternator/ — alternatore produce tensione alternata rettificata in continua.

rows.text: Si el alternador no carga, los consumidores eléctricos gastan la carga restante de la batería: no necesariamente se descarga de inmediato.
evidence: HELLA, Service work on the charging system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/us/technical/car-electronics-and-electrics/starting-and-charging-system/service-work-on-the-charging-system/ — alternatore alimenta utenze e mantiene la carica.

Volvo Trucks, Charging and maintenance tips, https://www.volvotrucks.com/content/dam/volvo-trucks/markets/hong-kong/truck/stay-in-power/Battery%20consumption%20awareness%20brochure%20WEB.pdf — le utenze consumano la carica residua durante le soste.

rows.text: No se agrega anticongelante a la batería. En las que admiten relleno se usa agua destilada según las instrucciones del fabricante.
evidence: Trojan Battery, How to Maintain Your Flooded Lead Acid Battery, Inspecting and Cleaning / Watering, https://www.trojanbattery.com/resources/white-papers-and-articles/how-to-maintain-your-flooded-lead-acid-battery — mantenere pulito e asciutto; vaselina o spray protettivo sui terminali contro la corrosione; solo acqua, preferibilmente distillata, nelle celle.

Suzuki, Warranty and Service Record Booklet, pp. 29–30, Battery fluid level, https://suzukimyanmar.com/frontend/assets/pdf/service/warranty-policy/Warranty_and_Service_Record_Booklet_EN.pdf — verifica del livello, rabbocco con acqua distillata a motore fermo; le sigillate non richiedono rabbocco.

rows.text: No existe el requisito de usar agua a más de 25 °C. En una batería rellenable se usa agua destilada y se siguen las instrucciones sobre el nivel.
evidence: Suzuki, Warranty and Service Record Booklet, pp. 29–30, Battery fluid level, https://suzukimyanmar.com/frontend/assets/pdf/service/warranty-policy/Warranty_and_Service_Record_Booklet_EN.pdf — verifica del livello, rabbocco con acqua distillata a motore fermo; le sigillate non richiedono rabbocco.

US War Department, TM 10-580, Automotive Electricity (1941), §30(b), https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-W-f4c669ada8e9a7de286bbc594c3aa140/html/GOVPUB-W-f4c669ada8e9a7de286bbc594c3aa140.htm — sotto zero si aggiunge acqua quando il motore sarà messo in moto per miscelarla; nessuna soglia minima di 25 °C per l’acqua è prescritta.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO: que el motor aún esté caliente no establece por sí solo una prohibición general. En una batería rellenable sigue las instrucciones del fabricante, con el motor apagado y acceso seguro; las selladas no se rellenan.
evidence: https://suzukimyanmar.com/frontend/assets/pdf/service/warranty-policy/Warranty_and_Service_Record_Booklet_EN.pdf — Suzuki, p. 29 stampata (PDF p. 37): rabbocco con acqua distillata per batteria ispezionabile a motore spento; batteria sigillata esente. Non dimostra sicurezza di operare su batteria calda.

rows.text: Conectar directamente los polos provoca un cortocircuito y puede producir chispas; no reemplaza la carga del alternador.
evidence: Bosch, Battery catalogue 2023, Automotive Battery Handling Procedure, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/in/services_and_support_1/downloads_10/pdf_5/battery_catalogue_2023.pdf — il contatto metallico tra morsetti causa cortocircuiti e scintille.

HELLA, Service work on the charging system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/us/technical/car-electronics-and-electrics/starting-and-charging-system/service-work-on-the-charging-system/ — alternatore alimenta utenze e mantiene la carica.

rows.text: La batería también alimenta consumidores y accesorios eléctricos, además del sistema de arranque del motor.
evidence: US DOE, How Do Diesel Vehicles Work?, https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-diesel-cars-work — batteria alimenta avviamento e accessori; gasolio si accende per compressione.

rows.text: La batería puede alimentar consumidores con el motor apagado; no se desconecta automáticamente cada vez que este se detiene.
evidence: US DOE, How Do Diesel Vehicles Work?, https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-diesel-cars-work — batteria alimenta avviamento e accessori; gasolio si accende per compressione.

Volvo Trucks, Charging and maintenance tips, https://www.volvotrucks.com/content/dam/volvo-trucks/markets/hong-kong/truck/stay-in-power/Battery%20consumption%20awareness%20brochure%20WEB.pdf — le utenze consumano la carica residua durante le soste.

rows.text: La batería almacena energía química y suministra corriente continua, no alterna.
evidence: US DOE, Batteries, https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1011-92_VOL2.pdf, ES-04 p.4 — batteria immagazzina energia chimica e la converte in elettrica.
US DOE, The War of the Currents, https://www.energy.gov/articles/war-currents-ac-vs-dc-power — la batteria eroga corrente continua, in un senso.

rows.text: En el motor de gasolina de encendido por chispa, la chispa enciende la mezcla comprimida de aire y combustible en el cilindro.
evidence: US DOE, Internal Combustion Engine Basics, https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — scintilla accende miscela benzina; nel diesel si inietta combustibile in aria compressa calda.

rows.text: En el diésel, el combustible inyectado se enciende por el calor del aire comprimido, no por una chispa.
evidence: US DOE, How Do Diesel Vehicles Work?, https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-diesel-cars-work — batteria alimenta avviamento e accessori; gasolio si accende per compressione.

US DOE, Internal Combustion Engine Basics, https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — scintilla accende miscela benzina; nel diesel si inietta combustibile in aria compressa calda.

rows.text: El motor diésel enciende el combustible con aire comprimido caliente: no necesita dos bujías de chispa por cilindro.
evidence: US DOE, Internal Combustion Engine Basics, https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — scintilla accende miscela benzina; nel diesel si inietta combustibile in aria compressa calda.

rows.text: En el diésel, el combustible se enciende en aire caliente comprimido y las bujías de precalentamiento ayudan al arranque en frío. Las de chispa producen la chispa en motores de encendido provocado. Sus funciones son distintas y no se deduce una regla general de mayor resistencia al calor.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — DOE: accensione a scintilla e per compressione.
https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/glow/ceramic-low-voltage-glow-plug/ — Bosch: funzioni e riscaldamento delle termocandele Diesel.

rows.text: El alternador accionado por el motor transforma energía mecánica en energía eléctrica alterna; un rectificador la convierte para el sistema eléctrico.
evidence: HELLA, Checking the alternator, https://www.hella.com/techworld/sg/technical/car-electronics-and-electrics/starting-and-charging-system/checking-the-alternator/ — alternatore produce tensione alternata rettificata in continua.

HELLA, Service work on the charging system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/us/technical/car-electronics-and-electrics/starting-and-charging-system/service-work-on-the-charging-system/ — alternatore alimenta utenze e mantiene la carica.

rows.text: El testigo puede encenderse normalmente al activar el contacto antes del arranque; si permanece encendido al conducir, indica un posible problema de carga. Detente de forma segura y sigue el manual del vehículo.
evidence: Nissan Qashqai 2024, Charge warning light, https://www.nissan.ie/ownership/owners-manuals/manuals.html/iom/qashqai/0j12/e1/2024/charge-warning-light-1.shtml — la spia si accende al quadro e si spegne dopo l’avvio; se accesa in marcia fermarsi in sicurezza e verificare.

issues.reason: La risposta stampata è FALSO, ma non è stata trovata una fonte che autorizzi esplicitamente il rabbocco con acqua distillata mentre il motore è ancora caldo. La sequenza di controlli del gruppo elettrogeno non stabilisce né che il rabbocco avvenga subito dopo la prova né la temperatura del motore; occorre adjudicazione della condizione specifica.
checked_sources: IIT Delhi, NIT3171, Annexure E-2, p. 49, Weekly checks (i)–(ii), https://home.iitd.ac.in/public/storage/tenders_archives/NIT3171.pdf — elenca prova sotto carico e controllo/rabbocco della batteria, senza precisare intervallo o temperatura del motore.

Suzuki, Warranty and Service Record Booklet, pp. 29–30, Battery fluid level, https://suzukimyanmar.com/frontend/assets/pdf/service/warranty-policy/Warranty_and_Service_Record_Booklet_EN.pdf — istruzioni di rabbocco a motore spento, senza indicare se ancora caldo.
U.S. Army FM 9-207, p. 3-12, https://ciehub.info/ref/FM/9-207_1998.pdf — in condizioni di freddo estremo prescrive una batteria calda e in carica, ma non specifica la temperatura del motore.

issues.reason: La risposta stampata è FALSO, ma il termine candele non specifica il tipo: i diesel possono impiegare candelette di preriscaldo. Le fonti consultate distinguono queste dalle candele a scintilla, ma non dimostrano una regola comparativa di resistenza al calore che permetta di correggere la motivazione esatta della domanda.
checked_sources: U.S. Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics, https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — distingue accensione a scintilla e accensione diesel per compressione, senza confronto di resistenza delle candele.

Bosch, Ceramic low-voltage glow plug, https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/glow/ceramic-low-voltage-glow-plug/ — descrive una candeletta diesel, il suo ruolo nel preriscaldo e la temperatura massima del modello, senza confronto generale con candele a scintilla.

Bosch, Glow Plugs, https://www.boschautoparts.com/p/glow-plugs-80049- — distingue la candeletta diesel dalla candela a scintilla e descrive temperature di funzionamento della candeletta, senza stabilire il confronto universale richiesto.

29515: saying battery mass can affect energy and dynamics does not explain the adverse effect asserted in the true question. Explain a supported negative consequence, such as greater energy consumption for a given operation, consistently in all four languages; DOE chapter 13, pp. 13-11–12 discusses mass and energy consumption.

29521: the cited Fiat manual timed out and the cited Yuasa PDF returned 404. Neither source has been verified for the claim that topping up is permissible with a warm engine; the described burn warning alone would not establish that claim. Supply an accessible authoritative example or instruction supporting the distinction and safety conditions.

issues.reason: The IIT Delhi list does not specify that the battery is topped up immediately after the load test while the engine remains warm; Suzuki does not address engine temperature. The categorical permission in the explanation therefore lacks direct authoritative support. Provide a source explicitly permitting this condition or revise after source adjudication.

The explanation assumes the question compares spark plugs, but diesel engines can have glow plugs. The cited DOE source establishes compression ignition but does not resolve the claimed relative heat resistance or establish that the comparison is invalid. Clarify the plug types and support the decisive correction with authoritative evidence without overriding the printed verdict.
